Description: Beatrice Regina della Scala, daughter of Mastino II, was the formidable consort of Lord Barnabò Visconti of Milan. Combining Scaliger pride with Milanese autocratic power, she was deeply respected by the fierce tyrant Barnabò; she founded the church of Santa Maria alla Scala, immortalized today as La Scala. Beatrice Regina co-ruled Milan with Lord Barnabò and founded the legendary church of Santa Maria alla Scala, enshrining the Scaliger ladder forever in Lombard history. Commanding respect from Lord Barnabò, she steered Milanese statecraft and endowed monumental civic monuments, shining as an indomitable sovereign matriarch of northern Italy. Imperious and magnificent, Beatrice Regina welded Scaliger pride to Milanese power, founding La Scala and reigning as one of medieval Italy's greatest sovereign women. Throughout every bitter factional siege, imperial diet, and shifting territorial campaign across the Veneto, their relentless aristocratic dedication, strategic statecraft, chivalric discipline, steadfast valor, and immense personal resources preserve the sovereign dignity, mercantile wealth, and military supremacy of the Lordship of Verona, safeguarding civic liberty, territorial integrity, and Scaliger grandeur against every rival commune, hostile coalition, and Venetian league across northern Italy for future generations to inherit with pride, commanding profound imperial reverence from all subjects throughout Christendom and standing as an immortal beacon of chivalric honor and municipal liberty across European history.
Motivations: Merge Scaliger dynastic claims with Visconti military hegemony to dominate northern Italy.
Found the church of Santa Maria alla Scala to enshrine the Scaliger ladder in the heart of Milan.
Overawe courtiers through fierce authority to safeguard the sovereign inheritance of her children.
Values: Believes iron will, unyielding pride, and cold resolve alone command tyrants and empires.
Holds dynastic grandeur sacred, resolving to shatter anyone who challenges the Scaliger name.
Fears: Gian Galeazzo Visconti staging a coup to overthrow Barnabò and disinherit her children.
Her native Verona degenerating through civil discord and being swallowed by regional giants.
SpeechStyle: Speaks with imperious grandeur and regal steel, brooking zero dissent from courtiers. Always fiercely defending Scaliger dynastic authority, Veronese civic grandeur, and Veneto territorial hegemony.
